name: OptionRow
description:
One option's content: icon, label and description with matches emphasised, meta on
the right and an optional ✓ column. A disabled option shows its reason as the second line.

props.name: check
props.description: Reserve a trailing column for a ✓ (pass the indicator element to fill it).

props.name: item
props.description: The typed item displayed or acted upon.

props.name: query
props.description: The text being searched for; matches are emphasised.
